Cars 2.name: Cars 2
Cars 2.summary: Inspired by the Disney•Pixar animated film, Cars 2: The Video Game lets players jump into the Cars 2 universe with some of their favorite Cars personalities in exotic locations around the globe.

Kawaii Pet to Kurasou! Wan Nyan & Idol A.name: Kawaii Pet to Kurasou! Wan Nyan & Idol Animal
Kawaii Pet to Kurasou! Wan Nyan & Idol A.summary: Kawaii Pet to Kurasou! Wan Nyan & Idol Animal lets you choose an adorable virtual pet to adopt, train, wash, love, feed and entertain. You'll have hours of furry fun playing your pet's breed, unique personality, fur and eye color and the accessories it will wear while you play.
